         Noctua and Prusa launch PETG filament for self-printed GPU coolers

Noctua and Prusa Research have released Prusament PETG filament in Noctua Beige and Noctua Brown. The material is intended for custom PC cases, electronic enclosures and air ducts, including user-designed GPU fan shrouds and cooling brackets.
